title: The victorious kayaking fun crew!
text: Great! The tour guide was friendly, informative and fun! I would recommend this activity to all; if one thinks they think it’s too challenging, the tour guide is patient and encouraging. Highly recommended!

title: A Nice Experience
text: Our guide Valentina was lovely. She shared information with us about what we were seeing on the water. One thing to know is that the kayaks are doubles. They are also inflatable which I found to be very stable and easy to maneuver. The time on the water is about an hour.
author: lisareff
